definitions.full: H5944. aliyyah עֲלִיָּה noun feminine (c. adjective masculine Jer 22:14 , compare Albr ZAW xvi (1896), 83 Kö Synt. § 251 k ) roof-chamber (Late Hebrew id. , עֲלִיתָא ᵑ7 , Syriac (whence Arabic dining-room as loan-word Frä 20f. ); Sabean עלית DHM Epigr. Denkm. 27 ); — chamber on roof, cool and secluded: absolute ׳ע Judg 3:23-24 , 25 (compare Nes Marg. 13 ), 1Kin 17:19 , 23 ; 2Kin 4:11 ; construct הַמְּקֵרָה עֲלִיַּת Judg 3:20 , קִֿיר׳ע 2Kin 4:10 roof-chamber with walls (permanent); ׳ע הַשַּׁעַר 2Sam 19:1 , i.e. over the gateway; ׳ע הַמִּנָּה Neh 3:31-32 , i.e. at a corner of the wall; ׳ע אָחָז 2Kin 23:12 (probably built by A.); suffix עֲלִיָּתוֺ 1:2 (belonging to Ahaziah); — 2Chr 9:4 read עֹלֹתָיו (compare || 1Kin 10:5 ); plural absolute מְרֻוָּחִים עֲלִיּוֺת Jer 22:14 spacious roof-chambers ; in Solomon's temple according to 2Chr 3:9 , so suffix עֲלִיּתָיו 1Chr 28:11 ; more Generally עֲלִיּוֺתָיו Jer 22:13 ; ׳י 's chambers in sky Psa 104:3 , containing rain, 104:13 .
